gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a wide gap where each c ends, while Fuzzy Bubbles draws its rounded handwriting with a compass-like line. Over a full page it reads friendly and unhurried.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-heebo: Relaxed, rounded handwriting from Fuzzy Bubbles leads, drawn with the steady line of a drafting pen. Heebo follows with a tall central band, and down a full page its curves stop short and stay easy.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hind-guntur: Drafting-pen steadiness runs through Fuzzy Bubbles, all rounded, open handwriting with small letters nearly capital height. But Hind Guntur is the sturdy one, wide curve gaps and lowercase standing tall like stamped metal.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai is a sans-serif whose s curves open wide at both ends. Fuzzy Bubbles does relaxed, personal handwriting best, while the body fills each line with lowercase that stands almost like capitals.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru, plain sans, leaves every lowercase a with its mouth ajar. Under Fuzzy Bubbles' relaxed handwriting, a full page of it reads with no calligraphic thinning, steady and modern.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hind-siliguri: Fuzzy Bubbles draws rounded, open letters with a drafting pen's steady line. Handwriting is its best trick, while Hind Siliguri hums along in flat gray, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-hind-vadodara: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles writes in rounded, open letters with a steady drafting-pen line. And Hind Vadodara's spacious terminal gaps and uniform line are what make the mix of hand and machine work.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-huninn: Fuzzy Bubbles writes with rounded, open handwriting and small letters almost as tall as its capitals, steady as a drafting pen. Huninn's lowercase rises close to cap height, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-inter-tight: Rounded, open handwriting is the signature of Fuzzy Bubbles, with small letters nearly capital height. And Inter Tight keeps paragraphs smooth and modern, short ascenders and held-back curve tails barely stirring the line.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-julius-sans-one: Spacious and open-ended, this body face barely steps down from capitals, set beside Fuzzy Bubbles' relaxed handwriting. Julius Sans One, plain sans through and through, leaves big gaps between letters so paragraphs feel light.
